candidates.reason: All eight frozen recall profiles must qualify before graph vector scoring can move to Rust. The 100k synthetic diagnostic found a large non-SQL envelope worth revisiting when that prerequisite is met.
The production matching span combines SQL lookup and TypeScript matching. The reduced run cannot establish how much wall time a native matcher could recover.
The loader accounts for most of the observed analysis envelope. It combines SQLite paging and row decoding. The observation does not isolate the proposed native work.

The release already uses bounded native inflate. Validation is the largest isolated decode stage. A batch prototype would need to recover enough time after transferring and reconstructing the decoded facts in Bun.
